parameters.name: City
parameters.description: The name or ID of the city where the carrier detection point is located.

parameters.name: IdcProbe
parameters.description: Specifies whether to return only detection points in data centers.

parameters.name: Ipv4
parameters.description: Specifies whether to return only IPv4 detection points.

parameters.name: Ipv6
parameters.description: Specifies whether to return only IPv6 detection points.

parameters.name: Isp
parameters.description: The name or ID of the carrier.

parameters.name: LmProbe
parameters.description: Specifies whether to return only last-mile detection points.

parameters.name: MbProbe
parameters.description: Specifies whether to return only mobile detection points.

parameters.name: ViewAll
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to return all detection points. Valid values:

- false (default): Returns the detection points that are available to you.

- true: Returns all detection points.
